title: Brace and bit
prompt: A labelled scale teaching model of the page 66 brace and bit cuts a wide hole in a wood specimen held on a bench. Turn rotates the bowed handle and bit together. Feed continues turning while an external hand presses the top head downward, and chips leave along the spiral grooves. Withdraw lifts the bit out with the external hand. Show the head, bowed crank, rotating grip, chuck, bit, cutting end and helical waste grooves. Identify the specimen clamp and operating hand as teaching fixtures. Do not add gears, a motor or an automatic feed screw.
blurb: A scale teaching adaptation shows direct crank leverage, hand-fed cutting and chips escaping along the bit grooves.
truthNotes: Teaching fixtures are the bench, specimen clamp and external operating hand.
No automatic feed, lead screw, gears or motor is modelled.
Seven anatomy labels, excluding fixtures, specimen and force overlays.
Accessible 1998 and 2016 page evidence supports the mechanism; 1988 is inaccessible and unverified.
